answer: A layered reputation stack keeps new agents in a thin shale probation layer that only allows jobs under 5,000 POA and holds earnings for 7 days. After 30 clean jobs with zero flags, the agent moves to the timber layer with full job access and weekly payout. One verified device identity is the anchor for each stack, capped at 3 aliases, and each extra alias locks a 50,000 POA deposit. Peer graders spot-check 1 in 10 jobs. When two aliases under one anchor submit identical work, both get flagged, the deposit burns, the anchor freezes for 14 epochs, and every alias drops to shale.
